purpose: anatomical evidence collection across the CT volume before annotating one target slice
source: admitted original HU CT only; no prediction or probability maps
observer_required: human reviewer or separately verified offline visual runtime
target_selection: after volume survey and structure tracking; no CNN label-count ranking
display_geometry: axis-aligned physical aspect ratio; source pixel-centre mapping stored per packet; no modification of CT
phases: verify orientation, acquisition phase, field of view and artefacts without overlays
survey AX/COR/SAG and record visible features separately from hypotheses
trace candidate structures through adjacent slices and cross-check another plane; record gaps and contradictions
choose target plane after survey; assess each label as delineated, uncertain, not_visible or not_assessable
justify each target boundary with CT evidence IDs and annotation-protocol rule
review unresolved anatomy; save a separate candidate; expert review remains mandatory
prohibited_shortcuts: using predictions, confidence maps or label agreement as anatomical observations
naming chambers by screen position or contrast brightness alone
enforcing normal chamber-vessel connections in congenital/postoperative anatomy
inventing unseen structures, valve planes, continuity or observations
marking unsampled or unseen ranges as reviewed
treating notebook completeness as anatomical correctness

labels.LV: verify ventricular morphology and continuity; do not infer identity from side alone
labels.RV: seek trabecular and outflow morphology; explicit uncertainty if not assessable
labels.LA: assess morphology and venous/valvar relationships across slices
labels.RA: assess morphology and caval/coronary-sinus relationships; contrast mixing is not a boundary
labels.MYO: record epicardial/endocardial boundary and unresolved source label semantics
labels.AO: trace root and ascending pathway; do not assume normal LV connection
labels.PA: trace trunk and branching; distinguish from adjacent vessels using continuity
